title: Biidaasige Park Extension Offers Art, Recreation, and Spectacular Views
summary: In the summer of 2025, the first 49-acre section of Biidaasige Park opened to the public to much fanfare. Thousands of visitors have since made their way to the banks of the newly rerouted Don River and to Ookwemin Minising, the new island carved out of the former industrial site in Toronto's Port Lands. Now, a year later, the next phase of the park is opening to the public on July 25, adding an additional 10 acres of parkland directly on the shores of Lake Ontario.
